QuestInfo.name: Medicine for Cutie
QuestInfo.0: See the doctor in Edelstein to make sure the stolen child is okay.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152004# says that the child is safe, but will need some proper medicine before she can make a full recovery. The people of Edelstein are as much victims as the Elves, so why not help them out?\r\n\r\n#questorder1##i4000058:# #t4000058:# #c4000058# / 77

0.0: Oh, you must be the one Thea told me about! You do remember Thea, don't you? If you don't recognize the name, don't worry. Everyone in town just calls her Cutie. Anyway, thank you for saving her. We owe you one.\r\n#L0##bYou don't owe me anything. Is Cutie okay?#l\n#k
0.1: She's a bit weak, but she'll be okay. Right now I'm just trying to help her get over the shock of being kidnapped by the Black Wings.\r\n#L0##bAny way I can help?#l\n#k
0.2: You've already done so much for us. We couldn't possibly accept your help. But if you insist, I'm sure I can come up with something for you to do!

yes.0: I'm trying to brew up a little something up to help her feel better. The #b#t4000058#s#k in #b#m200000000##k are all I'm missing. If you wouldn't mind gathering some for me, I only need #b77#k.

1.0: My, my, you are quite strong, aren't you? And you seem to hate the Black Wings just as much as we do... I wonder if we'll work together someday?

item.0: Have you gotten the #b#t4000058##ks yet? #o4230105#s are plants that grow in #m200000000#.
